name: furnace_efficiency
source: AmCraX workstream H; no sourced fired-heater efficiency in the library (economics.yaml uses 1.0)
applicability_note: Applied only to supplementary NH3 fuel; tail-gas heat is credited by the pinch model. Range 0.65-1.0 in sensitivities.

name: thermal_loss_fraction
unit: fraction of reactor + trim heater duty
applicability_note: Added to the fired duty; the existing KPIs have no losses (fact sheet F7).

name: catalyst_price_Ni
source: cho2026nickel Table 4 p. 7 (Ni/Al2O3 8 wt% 33.4, Ru-K/CaO 3 wt% 542 USD/kg)
applicability_note: Used as a proxy for Ni/MgO (assumption).

name: catalyst_price_Ru
source: cho2026nickel Table 4 p. 7 (Ni/Al2O3 8 wt% 33.4, Ru-K/CaO 3 wt% 542 USD/kg)
applicability_note: Used as a proxy for Ru/Al2O3, Ru/MgO and as an upper bound for NiRu/CeO2 (assumption).

name: catalyst_lifetime
source: cho2026nickel Table 4 (an assumption in the source)

name: feed_basis
applicability_note: Kinetics use the 99.8 kmol/h NH3 only.

name: kinetic_reactor
value: isothermal PFR, no pressure drop, effectiveness factor 1
applicability_note: Powder kinetics applied to an industrial bed; all laws extrapolated to 10-30 bar.

name: kinetic_conversion_in_flowsheet
value: cracker outlet conversion fixed at the kinetic target X
source: amcrax.process_model.run_python_case with solve_equilibrium replaced by X (never above equilibrium)
applicability_note: Same H-T property basis as the Python flowsheet.

name: cracker_capex_scaling
source: scaling exponent of the Singapore equipment CAPEX (Chopra 2026 Eq. 5) applied to catalyst volume
applicability_note: Sensitivity only; in the base case CAPEX does not respond to catalyst volume.
